dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: I have a strange cảm giác that we've talked about phẫu thuật thẩm mỹ before. Do you think it has become too common in Vietnam?

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: That cảm giác, I have it too. Phẫu thuật thẩm mỹ is growing rapidly here, but I think people should be free to choose for their bodies.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Freedom to choose is one thing, but I see many young girls being pressured to look alike. They lose their tự nhiên beauty and identity.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: I understand your perspective. But sometimes phẫu thuật thẩm mỹ helps people feel more confident. Have you ever thought about wanting to thay đổi something about yourself?

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Never! I believe in tự nhiên beauty. But... I wonder, do you thích women who are natural or those who've had phẫu thuật thẩm mỹ?

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: I thích people who are true to themselves. Like you, Mira... tự nhiên and not afraid to express your views. Phẫu thuật thẩm mỹ can thay đổi a face, but it can't thay đổi the soul.
